changes.issue: Legacy hard square strokes had been approximated by soft maximum-coverage dabs, changing integer boundary pixels, ignored options and repeated-event alpha.
changes.fix: Dedicated clipped scanline algorithm with width1 fixed-point line path. Floor document coordinates, integer brush size; hard square normalizes opacity/hardness/stabilization/pressure to the legacy policy. Existing straight RGBA composition remains.
changes.compatibility: Geometry/events are compared with Qt6.12 observations. Qt premultiplied color rounding is not imposed on straight-RGBA storage. This does not establish every Qt/platform/input combination.

changes.issue: Square pointer release and other mouse-button transitions were replayed as drawing moves, darkening translucent ink.
changes.reproduction: Left+middle stationary click became [88,135,206,255] or [79,142,216,255] rather than two-pass [121,108,165,255], depending on release order.
changes.fix: Ignore nonowner mouse button transitions for active hard square strokes. Let endStroke handle a changed terminal endpoint once; real drawing/coalesced moves retain their event semantics.

changes.issue: Inactive hard-square options appeared editable and the explanatory state did not refresh immediately.
changes.fix: Synchronize on square toggle, disable inapplicable options, preserve their values for returning to round mode, show a concise explanation using existing skin tokens.

changes.issue: Hard square strokes retained an unused per-pixel maximum-coverage plane.
changes.fix: Keep only original touched-tile snapshots for hard square. Shared tile allocation commits registration after allocations; round mode retains its coverage plane.

architecture.helpers: captureStrokeTile owns shared before-image allocation/registration; moveSquareStroke separates a distinct raster algorithm from the round hot path; rasterMultiplyAdd is a bounded shared numeric algorithm. Sequential work remains within these owning methods.
architecture.numericPolicy: Exact signed integer mantissa product+sum, one Number rounding at bounded clip/intercept boundaries. BigInt is outside row/pixel loops. Cap shifts retain separate multiply/add rounding.

geometry.scope: These are fixture cases inside seven new Node tests, not 5397 separate test-runner tests. Source geometry and independent literal RGBA are asserted without tolerance.

numeric.scope: Executed before removing unused coverage; numeric helper body unchanged in final source. Not a universal IEEE754 fma proof.

native.scope: Actual macOS release/WKWebView, filesystem recovery, codec, quit and scene runs. The three square checks are in-app JavaScriptCore checks, not physical pointer automation. No Windows, OS file-dialog, signing or notarization acceptance.

verification.ci: Added test:square-contract to the existing web job. Remote CI has not been executed in this work.

performance.interpretation: Same output hashes/history in four matched round cases. Final medians range from about -1.3% to +5.2%; small samples, not zero-regression/p95/physical latency proof. Earlier same-process cohorts showed variance and are retained; no GC/JIT causal attribution.

algorithmWork.scope: Instrumented bounded work and reachable ArrayBuffers; instrumented and ordinary outputs agree. Not RSS/GPU memory or hard-square versus old-soft-square speedup.
